title: The Horde — 15 adaptive score families
status: Composition and synthesized review package. No game integration or production mastering claim.
provenance: Existing What the Dark Keeps score supplied from the private Horde repository. New companion scores and arrangements authored by OpenAI assistant for the user; existing author attribution is retained in the source package, not reassigned. No paid generation or third-party recordings.
audio_status: Actual Pocket Audio Core deterministic reference renders; not verified exact v68 live instrument parity. Instrument IDs are engine synthesis, not acoustic recordings.
integration_status: Future state-to-section proposal only. Current native eight-cue game and accepted original source are untouched.
runtime_gaps: True section-end scheduling is needed: current Core section quantization means bar.
Stinger events need an actual playback consumer.
thenReturnTo metadata needs a functioning return scheduler.
Layer control, dialogue ducking, saved state, pause/resume and native registration require integration and device tests.

families.title: What the Dark Keeps
families.scale: minor with intentional chromatic melody and F# release
notes: A/D retained short third-part A4 is not a held drone.
This file is not an overwrite of the current game asset.

families.title: The Fourth Keeper's Rest
families.motif_treatment: M is incomplete and low, with wide rests and unresolved final note; it describes custody and the buried past.
families.story_guardrails: Stillness; exploration; guards alerted/combat; safe aftermath. Kit's early grate call ducks the music. No lantern-associated reveal before reward.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch
families.loop_note: Each loopable block rendered with prior-cycle carryover by actual Core engine; listenable arrangement is one possible path, not a scripted gameplay timer.

families.title: The Jailer's Last Vigil
families.motif_treatment: M becomes a stern defensive phrase rather than an evil-theme caricature; the defeat reduces to a questioning fragment.
families.story_guardrails: Proposed music states: reveal, active defence, late pressure, confirmed defeat, lantern claim. Phase entry follows gameplay events, not a fixed recording timeline; attack tells remain independent.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch
families.loop_note: Each loopable block rendered with prior-cycle carryover by actual Core engine; listenable arrangement is one possible path, not a scripted gameplay timer.

families.title: Beneath the Same Moon
families.motif_treatment: M receives a softer answering phrase COMPANION, a new proposal representing companionship rather than a voiced player response.
families.story_guardrails: Relief; quiet travel; optional threat overlay; lantern clue; lookout vista. Remain nocturnal, never announce dawn or curse lifted. Kit dialogue gets long rests.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch
families.loop_note: Each loopable block rendered with prior-cycle carryover by actual Core engine; listenable arrangement is one possible path, not a scripted gameplay timer.

families.title: The Roads of Veyr
families.motif_treatment: M becomes a walking figure; destination timbres enter before the next area. Starter shrine stretches it into a contemplative phrase.
families.story_guardrails: Travel; hesitation/access task; threat; safe shrine; completed return. No separate songs for each upgrade route. Use destination overlays only when narratively appropriate.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: Bellwether, Still Burning
families.motif_treatment: M is answered with COMPANION in a modest communal tune HOME; warmth and belonging temper greed without pretending danger is over.
families.story_guardrails: Streets; tavern/services; reflective churchyard; story-changed return. Mill/smith activity stays diegetic SFX; don't commission full tracks per shop or infer a supernatural bell event.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: Bells Beneath the Water
families.motif_treatment: M is spaced like a broken liturgy; answering fragments suggest reflected light, without audio alone revealing the puzzle solution.
families.story_guardrails: Vista; short crossing; dry exploration; reflector practice/puzzle; duty-hall threat; post-seal reflection. Muffled texture belongs only to crossing/wet views, not the whole dry dungeon. No ocean palette.

families.title: The Bellkeeper
families.motif_treatment: M is a measured bell/processional figure, opened into a clear higher-register answer during valid reflected-light exposure.
families.story_guardrails: Armoured; reflected-light setup; actual exposure; recovery; final pressure if gameplay supports it; confirmed defeat. Music supports the learned reflector/shutter rule; never creates a mandatory rhythm puzzle or masks warnings.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: The King's Account
families.motif_treatment: M is reduced to repeated work-shaped cells with displaced accents; a held tone mirrors leaving light in place while moving.
families.story_guardrails: Approach; machinery exploration; stand lesson; smoke/cover pressure; cleared archive. Harmonic treatment cannot imply Abbey already happened. Mechanical hazards/timing have independent audible cues.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: Master of Coin
families.motif_treatment: M is compressed and insistently repeated; the answer opens only for earned mechanism/exposure windows.
families.story_guardrails: Shell protected; mechanism maintained; exposed; recovery; later pressure if authored; confirmed defeat. Keep soundscape gaps for fire, shutter and attack tells. No industrial/electronic or science-fiction identity.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: A Garden Behind Glass
families.motif_treatment: M becomes elegant and clearer in counterpoint; incomplete imitations suggest preserved beauty and contradictory history.
families.story_guardrails: Ridge/gate; winter garden; mirrored gallery; aperture lesson; royal records; approaching keeper. Both seals gate access; musical evolution may reflect that completed history. Reflections are finite, not a demand for spatial audio gimmicks.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: The Last Lucid Keeper
families.motif_treatment: M and its previously hidden answering contour trade registers; protection sounds sorrowful and purposeful. Do not use a triumphant kill cadence.
families.story_guardrails: Recognition/dialogue; wards intact; learned aperture action; vulnerability; confirmed defeat; evidence/revelation. Exact boss staging/survival remains undecided; state names must not hard-code killing.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: All That Was Carried Home
families.motif_treatment: M returns with genuine beauty; Abbey, Foundry and Court colours become recognizable echoes of plundered objects. Suspicion grows through harmonic context, not an early villain reveal.
families.story_guardrails: Awe; examine riches; prepare ritual; genuine release of soldiers; entity freed. Sequence triggered by authored events; players may linger indefinitely. This is compact finale staging, not a fourth full dungeon.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch

families.title: What the Dark Releases
families.motif_treatment: M appears in its most forceful distorted rhythm/register against the human COMPANION/HOME answer. Its recognizable identity is retained rather than replaced by generic boss music.
families.story_guardrails: Proposed musical phases only: confrontation, escalating pressure, culmination, actual defeat. No invented entity form, name, attack or new mandatory power. A/B/C can be selected by future authored encounter events.
families.trigger_status: Proposed authored events; not implemented runtime dispatch
families.loop_note: Each loopable block rendered with prior-cycle carryover by actual Core engine; listenable arrangement is one possible path, not a scripted gameplay timer.

families.title: Enough to Come Home
families.motif_treatment: M finally receives a settled answer from COMPANION/HOME; the ending is earned, modest and hopeful, not proof of a specific treasure distribution or daylight.
families.story_guardrails: Return road; changed home; quiet epilogue; optional credits. One ending only; no alternate keeper branch. Keep full unresolved narrative decisions out of music labels.

Faithful acoustic-seeming renderer voices, full envelope/filter/FX parity between editor/live/offline/native paths, without changing note or register intent.
True section-end queueing and cancellable state transitions with stinger playback and verified return.
Longer through-composed sections, variable-length forms and reusable arranged state loops beyond8blocks when engine supports them.
